name: Leslie Lauw
headline: DevOps engineer, steering *Kubernetes clusters* through the age of AI.
intro: I'm Leslie. At Notive I build cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters from scratch with Terraform, Helm and Argo CD, and keep them running. I'm still a software engineer too, so I see the platform from the *developer's side* as well.
description: Leslie Lauw is a DevOps engineer at Notive, building and running Kubernetes platforms with Terraform, Helm and Argo CD.

focus.title: What I work on
focus.intro: Day to day I'm responsible for the platform: from the first Terraform module to the dashboards we check in the morning.

items.title: Infrastructure as code
items.text: Our cloud infrastructure lives in Terraform, in Git. Environments can be rebuilt from the repository instead of from memory.

items.title: Kubernetes platforms
items.text: Cluster setup, the components around it and the Helm charts that install them, including monitoring and logging for clusters and apps.

items.title: GitOps delivery
items.text: Argo CD keeps what runs in the cluster in line with what's in Git, hooked into our CI/CD pipelines so a merge becomes a deploy.

experienceIntro: Writing software since 2020, running platforms since 2024.
writingIntro: Longer write-ups of projects I worked on.
